ja: 古池や蛙とびこむ水の音
en:
The old pond
a frog leaps in
the sound of water

ja: 閑さや岩にしみ入るせみの聲
en:
Such stillness
the cicadas' voices
seep into stone

ja: 夏草や兵どもが夢の跡
en:
Summer grasses
all that remains
of warriors' dreams

ja: 五月雨を集めて早し最上川
en:
Gathering the summer rains
how swiftly
the Mogami runs

ja: 荒海や佐渡に橫ふ天の川
en:
A rough sea
the Milky Way stretches
across to Sado

ja: 秋深き隣は何をする人ぞ
en:
Autumn deepens
the neighbor next door
what does he do?

ja: 旅に病んで夢は枯野をかけめぐる
en:
Sick on a journey
my dreams go running
over withered fields

ja: 海暮れて鴨の聲ほのかに白し
en:
The sea darkens
the ducks' cries
faintly white

ja: 旅人と我名呼ばれん初時雨
en:
Let them call me Traveler
the first winter shower

ja: 初時雨猿も小簑をほしげなり
en:
The first winter shower
even the monkey seems to want
a little straw cape

ja: 花の雲鐘は上野か淺草か
en:
A cloud of blossoms
is that bell from Ueno
or Asakusa?

ja: 此道や行く人なしに秋の暮
en:
This road
with no one on it
an autumn evening

ja: 雲をり〳〵人を休める月見哉
en:
Clouds from time to time
give us a rest
from moon-viewing

ja: 名月や北國日和定めなき
en:
Harvest moon
how changeable the weather
in the northern country

ja: 初雪や水仙の葉のたわむ程
en:
First snow
just enough to bend
the narcissus leaves

ja: 初雪やかけかゝりたる橋のうへ
en:
First snow
on the bridge
still being built

ja: 茶の花に人里ちかき山路哉
en:
Tea blossoms
a village close by
on the mountain path

ja: 梅が香にのつと日の出る山路哉
en:
Through the scent of plum blossoms
the sun suddenly rises
on the mountain path

ja: 霞やら花の雲やら煙やら
en:
Is it haze
a cloud of blossoms
or smoke?

ja: 春なれや名もなき山の朝霞
en:
So it is spring
morning haze
on a nameless mountain

ja: 春の海ひねもすのたりのたりかな
en:
The spring sea
all day long
lazily rising, falling

ja: 菜の花や月は東に日は西に
en:
Rapeseed blossoms
the moon in the east
the sun in the west

ja: 涼しさや鐘をはなるるかねの音
en:
Such coolness
the sound of the bell
leaves the bell behind

ja: 夏河を越すうれしさよ手に草履
en:
The joy of crossing
a summer river
sandals in my hand

ja: 牡丹散て打かさなりぬ二三片
en:
The peony scatters
piled one on another
two or three petals

ja: 狐火やいづこ河内の麦畠
en:
Foxfire
where in Kawachi's
wheat fields?

ja: さみだれや大河を前に家二軒
en:
Summer rains
two houses facing
a great river

ja: 去年より又さびしひぞ秋の暮
en:
Lonelier still
than last year
this autumn dusk

ja: あちらむきに鴫も立たり秋の暮
en:
Facing away
a snipe, too, stands
autumn dusk

ja: 弓取に哥とはれけり秋の暮
en:
A warrior asks me
about poetry
autumn dusk

ja: 秋の暮辻の地藏に油さす
en:
Autumn dusk
pouring oil for the lamp
of the crossroads Jizō

ja: 月天心貧しき町を通りけり
en:
The moon at the zenith
I pass through
a poor town

ja: 山は暮て野は黄昏の薄哉
en:
The mountains darken
in the field, twilight
and silver grass

ja: 鳥羽殿へ五六騎急ぐ野分かな
en:
Five or six riders
hurry toward Toba Palace
in the autumn gale

ja: 狐火や髑髏に雨のたまる夜に
en:
Foxfire
on a night when rain
collects in a skull

ja: 水鳥や舟に菜を洗ふ女有
en:
Waterbirds
a woman in a boat
washing greens

ja: 水鳥や枯木の中に駕二挺
en:
Waterbirds
among the bare trees
two palanquins

ja: 易水にねぶか流るゝ寒かな
en:
A leek drifts down
the Yi River
how cold it is

ja: 斧入れて香におどろくや冬こだち
en:
The axe bites
the scent takes me by surprise
a winter grove

ja: うまさふな雪やふふはりふふはりと
en:
Delicious-looking snow
so fluffy
so fluffy

ja: 旅人がかきねにはさむおち穂哉
en:
A traveler tucks
a fallen ear of rice
into the hedge

ja: やれ打な蝿が手をすり足をする
en:
Wait, don't swat it
the fly rubs its hands
rubs its feet

ja: 笠でするさらばさらばやうすがすみ
en:
A wave of the hat
goodbye, goodbye
through the thin haze

ja: 評判の八重山ざくらあゝ老ぬ
en:
That famous double mountain cherry
ah, I have grown old

ja: 門の木の阿房烏も初声ぞ
en:
Even the fool crow
in the tree by the gate
gives its first cry of the year

ja: 雀の子そこのけ〳〵御馬が通る
en:
Little sparrow
move aside, move aside
a horse is coming through

ja: 松陰に寝てくふ六十よ州かな
en:
In the shade of the pines
sixty-odd provinces
sleep and eat

ja: 足枕手まくら鹿のむつまじや
en:
Pillowed on each other's legs
how tenderly
the deer lie together

ja: なくななくなそれ程まめでかへる雁
en:
Don't cry, don't cry
you go home so healthy
wild geese

ja: させる夜もなくてふりゆく萩の花
en:
No night in particular
as the bush clover
sheds its flowers

ja: 井の中の蛙、大海を知らず
en: the frog in the well knows nothing of the great ocean
the ground hardens after it rains
a skilled hawk hides its talons
even Kōbō Daishi's brush slips
fortune comes to the house that laughs

ja: 塵も積もれば山となる
en: pile up even dust and it becomes a mountain
the stake that sticks out gets hammered down
time is money
the neighbor's lawn looks greener
let the one who proposes it go first
first a daughter, then a son
even monkeys fall from trees
wait for good fortune while you sleep
a frog's child is a frog
sweet words only please a fool
if you are in a hurry, go the long way around

ja: 郷に入っては郷に従え
en: when you enter a village, follow its ways
praying to the gods only when in trouble
leaving it unsaid is the flower
time flies like an arrow

ja: 三人寄れば文殊の知恵
en: three people together have the wisdom of the bodhisattva Monju
failure is the source of success
a curse falls when you are already weak
wherever you live becomes the capital
in spring one sleeps a sleep that knows no dawn
three women together make a racket
all human fortune is like the old frontiersman's horse
hurry to do good
things to fear: earthquake, thunder, fire, father
it is dark at the foot of the lamp stand

ja: 馬鹿は死ななきゃ治らない
en: a fool is not cured until he dies
necessity is the mother of invention
spilled water does not return to the tray
even the Buddha's face, only three times

ja: 坊主憎けりゃ袈裟まで憎い
en: hate the monk and you hate even his robe

ja: 落花枝に帰らず破鏡再び照らさず
en: fallen blossoms never return to the branch; a broken mirror never shines again
do not straighten your hat under a plum tree
the departing bird does not muddy the water

ja: 屁と火事はもとから騒ぐ
en: with farts and fires, the one who started it makes the most fuss
farting, then clenching your bottom
some bugs even like bitter smartweed
poverty makes you dull
a rolling stone gathers no moss

ja: 子を見ること親に如かず
en: no one sees a child as well as its parent

ja: 用心するに如くはない
en: caution is the best policy
kindness begets kindness
years of experience count more than a tortoise shell
even a kappa can be swept away by the river
to stop only in death

ja: 天網恢恢疎にして漏らさず
en: heaven's net has large meshes, but nothing escapes
upbringing over lineage
one does not serve two lords
even in busyness there is leisure

ja: 赤信号皆で渡れば怖くない
en: if everyone crosses against the red light together, there's nothing to be afraid of
where there is pleasure, there is pain
an inch ahead is darkness
whoever is fastest wins
study hard and play hard
do it, and it can be done
even a packhorse driver looks fine in good clothes
like calls to like
a lie, too, can be a skillful means

ja: 背に腹は変えられない
en: you cannot trade your belly for your back
the large can serve as the small

ja: 精神一到何事か成らざらん
en: with the spirit concentrated, what cannot be done?

ja: 渇しても盗泉の水を飲まず
en: even when thirsty, do not drink from the Thief's Spring
burned by hot soup, one blows on cold salad

ja: 瓜の蔓に茄子はならぬ
en: eggplants don't grow on melon vines

ja: 虎穴に入らずんば虎子を得ず
en: without entering the tiger's den, you cannot take its cub
a mended lid for a cracked pot
cranes live a thousand years, tortoises ten thousand

ja: 人事を尽くして天命を待つ
en: do all that people can, then await heaven's will
love turns pockmarks into dimples
a meowing cat catches no mice
genius and madness are a sheet of paper apart
the child does not know the parent's heart
you cannot wave a sleeve you don't have

ja: 負うた子に教えられて浅瀬を渡る
en: taught by the child on your back, you cross the shallows

ja: 溺れる者は藁をも掴む
en: a drowning man will clutch at a straw

ja: 勝って兜の緒を締めよ
en: after winning, tighten your helmet strap
in a melon field, do not stop to fix your shoes

ja: かわいい子には旅をさせよ
en: send a beloved child on a journey
a cornered rat will bite a cat

ja: 窮鳥懐に入れば猟師もこれを殺さず
en: when a cornered bird flies into his breast, even a hunter will not kill it

ja: おごる平家久しからず
en: the proud Heike did not last long

ja: 敵を欺くにはまず味方から
en: to deceive the enemy, first deceive your allies

ja: 入るを量りて出ずるを為す
en: measure what comes in before you spend

ja: 過ちては則ち改むるに憚ること勿れ
en: when you make a mistake, don't hesitate to correct it
persistence is power
rising early gains you three coins

ja: 雉も鳴かずば撃たれまい
en: the pheasant would not be shot if it did not cry

ja: 事実は小説より奇なり
en: truth is stranger than fiction
money goes around the world
the bonds between people are strange things
even rotten, a sea bream is a sea bream
behind the hidden side is another hidden side
one red flower amid a thicket of green

ja: 門前の小僧習わぬ経を読む
en: the boy at the temple gate recites sutras he was never taught
a bad wife is a hundred years of failed harvests
even a demon's eyes shed tears
there are green hills everywhere; go boldly out into the world

ja: すまじきものは宮仕え
en: serving a master is the thing to avoid
love is blind
hardship makes you a jewel
hearing a hundred times is not worth seeing once
seen at night, from afar, or under a hat, a woman looks loveliest
the third time is the true one

ja: 衣食足りて礼節を知る
en: with enough clothing and food, one learns manners

ja: 青は藍より出でて藍より青し
en: blue comes from indigo, yet is bluer than indigo
meeting is the beginning of parting
the autumn sun drops like a well bucket
mugwort growing among hemp grows straight
raindrops bore through stone
the net lets slip a fish big enough to swallow a boat
three years sitting on a stone will warm it
the dead have no mouths

ja: 風が吹けば桶屋が儲かる
en: when the wind blows, the bucket makers profit

ja: 口では大坂の城も建つ
en: with words alone you could build Osaka Castle

ja: 三尺去って師の影を踏まず
en: stay three feet back and never step on your teacher's shadow
trade is like an ox's drool: thin and unending
the autumn deer comes to the hunter's flute

ja: 壁に耳あり障子に目あり
en: walls have ears, and paper doors have eyes
ill-gotten money does not stay with you
the years wait for no one
idle waves in shallow water
there are no demons in the world we pass through
hardship is the seed of ease

ja: 楽は苦の種、苦は楽の種
en: ease is the seed of hardship; hardship is the seed of ease

ja: 山高きが故に貴からず
en: a mountain is not precious because it is high
illness comes from the mind

ja: 柳の下にいつも泥鰌はおらぬ
en: there aren't always loaches under the willow
willows do not snap under snow
buy cheap and lose your money
peaches and chestnuts take three years, persimmons eight

ja: 一年の計は元旦にあり
en: the year's plan lies in New Year's Day
one man's medicine is another's poison

ja: 本木にまさる末木なし
en: no later branch surpasses the original trunk
good medicine is bitter in the mouth

ja: 目は口ほどに物を言う
en: the eyes speak as much as the mouth

ja: 金の切れ目が縁の切れ目
en: when the money breaks off, so does the bond
on a journey, a companion; in the world, kindness

ja: 人の口には戸が立てられない
en: you cannot put a door on people's mouths

ja: 若い時の苦労は買うてもせよ
en: hardship in youth is worth buying
for men, courage; for women, charm
sweets go in a separate stomach
even dead trees add life to a mountain
even coarse tea is good when freshly brewed

ja: 少年老い易く学成り難し
en: youth fades quickly, learning comes slowly

ja: 一寸の光陰軽んずべからず
en: do not take lightly even an inch of time
the poor have no free time

ja: 天は自ら助くる者を助く
en: heaven helps those who help themselves
the pen is mightier than the sword
many arts is no art
silence is gold, eloquence is silver
strike while the iron is hot

ja: 働かざる者食うべからず
en: he who does not work shall not eat

ja: 死んで花実が咲くものか
en: can flowers bloom or fruit ripen after you are dead?
those who leave grow more distant each day
the blind leading the blind

ja: 己の欲せざる所は人に施す勿れ
en: what you do not wish for yourself, do not do to others
love your enemies
love your neighbor

ja: 過ちて改めざるこれを過ちという
en: to err and not correct it: that is the real error

ja: 千金の裘は一狐の腋に非ず
en: a fur coat worth a thousand gold is not made from one fox's armpit

ja: 宝さかって入る時はさかって出る
en: treasure that comes in wrongly goes out wrongly

ja: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる
en: a dog that walks will run into a stick
proof over argument
heart over looks
a child is the clamp that holds a marriage together

ja: 月夜の晩ばかりじゃない
en: it won't always be a moonlit night (watch your back)
curiosity killed the cat

ja: 親しき仲にも礼儀あり
en: even between close friends there is courtesy
winning and losing are the luck of the moment
under a brave general there are no weak soldiers
a man does not go back on his word
with preparation, there is no worry

ja: 情けは人のためならず
en: kindness is not only for the other person

ja: 冬来たりなば春遠からじ
en: if winter comes, can spring be far behind?
get used to it rather than study it
it's always darkest before the dawn

ja: 日光を見ずして結構と言うなかれ
en: don't call anything splendid until you've seen Nikko

ja: 船頭多くして船山に登る
en: too many boatmen and the boat climbs a mountain

ja: 女房と畳は新しい方が良い
en: wives and tatami mats are best when new

ja: 案ずるより産むが易し
en: giving birth is easier than worrying about it
the soul of a three-year-old lasts to a hundred

ja: 幽霊の正体見たり枯れ尾花
en: the ghost turned out to be withered pampas grass
it all depends on how you say it

ja: 過ぎたるは及ばざるがごとし
en: going too far is the same as falling short
appetite over romance
speak of someone and their shadow appears
the day you decide is the lucky day
heroes are fond of romance
the honest one ends up looking the fool

ja: 鬼が出るか蛇が出るか
en: will a demon come out, or a snake?
a cane before you fall

ja: 下手な考え休むに似たり
en: poor thinking is the same as resting
do not chase the one who leaves
do not refuse those who come

ja: 用心するに越したことはない
en: you can never be too careful
see Naples and die

ja: ローマは一日にして成らず
en: Rome was not built in a day

ja: 悪人は畳の上では死ねない
en: the wicked cannot die on the tatami at home
a bad law is still a law
whatever will be, will be

ja: 衣ばかりで和尚はできぬ
en: robes alone do not make a priest

ja: 一寸の虫にも五分の魂
en: even a one-inch bug has a half-inch soul

ja: 一銭を笑う者は一銭に泣く
en: laugh at a penny and you'll weep for a penny
a single-minded wish reaches heaven

ja: 嘘つきは泥棒の始まり
en: lying is the beginning of stealing
fortune lies with heaven

ja: 遠くの親類より近くの他人
en: a stranger nearby is better than a relative far away
the unskilled talk at length

ja: 可愛さ余って憎さ百倍
en: love overflowing becomes hatred a hundredfold

ja: 火のないところに煙は立たない
en: there's no smoke without fire

ja: 稼ぐに追いつく貧乏なし
en: no poverty can catch up with hard work

ja: 我が身をつねって人の痛さを知れ
en: pinch yourself to know how others feel pain

ja: 寄る年波には勝てない
en: no one can beat the rising waves of age

ja: 急いては事を仕損ずる
en: haste spoils the task

ja: 求めよさらば与えられん
en: ask, and it shall be given you

ja: 泣く子と地頭には勝てぬ
en: you cannot win against a crying child or the lord's steward
teaching is half of learning
enter through the narrow gate
money breeds money
money talks
lend your money and lose your friend
where there is pain, there is pleasure

ja: 君子危うきに近寄らず
en: the wise man does not go near danger
the wise man changes like a leopard's coat

ja: 鶏口となるも牛後となる勿れ
en: better the beak of a rooster than the tail of an ox
an art will support you

ja: 芸術は長く人生は短し
en: art is long, life is short
blood is thicker than water

ja: 健全なる精神は健全なる身体に宿る
en: a sound mind dwells in a sound body
the unseen is the flower

ja: 見ると聞くとは大違い
en: seeing something and hearing about it are very different

ja: 言うは易く行うは難し
en: easy to say, hard to do
your hometown is hard to forget

ja: 後は野となれ山となれ
en: after me, let it all turn to field or mountain
regret never comes first

ja: 乞食を三日すればやめられぬ
en: beg for three days and you can never stop
the mouth is the source of disaster

ja: 喉元過ぎれば熱さを忘れる
en: once past the throat, the heat is forgotten

ja: 好きこそものの上手なれ
en: what you love, you become good at
do not let a good chance slip

ja: 孝行のしたい時分に親はなし
en: by the time you want to care for your parents, they are gone

ja: 慌てる乞食はもらいが少ない
en: the hasty beggar gets little

ja: 降りかかる火の粉は払わねばならぬ
en: sparks that fall on you must be brushed off

ja: この親にしてこの子あり
en: such a parent, such a child

ja: 今日は人の身明日は我が身
en: what happens to another today may happen to me tomorrow

ja: 最後に笑う者が最もよく笑う
en: he who laughs last, laughs best
the talented fall by their own talent
yesterday's friend is today's enemy
the schemer drowns in his own schemes

ja: 山椒は小粒でもぴりりと辛い
en: the sansho pepper is small, but it bites

ja: 始め良ければ終わり良し
en: if the start is good, the end is good
a child is a yoke on the neck in all three worlds

ja: 子を持って知る親の恩
en: only when you have children do you know what you owe your parents

ja: 死んだ子の年を数える
en: counting the age of a dead child
utmost sincerity reaches heaven
a husband and wife alike in their ways
time will solve it
in times of peace, do not forget war
unsown seeds do not sprout

ja: 鹿を追う者は山を見ず
en: the hunter chasing the deer does not see the mountain

ja: 捨てる神あれば拾う神あり
en: if one god abandons you, another picks you up
a snake knows the ways of snakes

ja: 弱き者よ汝の名は女なり
en: frailty, thy name is woman

ja: 朱に交われば赤くなる
en: mix with vermilion and you turn red
sake is the chief of a hundred medicines

ja: 終わりよければすべてよし
en: all's well that ends well
habit becomes second nature
farts and boils don't choose their place
look at both sides of the shield
do not forget the beginner's mind
change the place and things change
heat and cold last only until the equinox
a woman's determination can pierce rock

ja: 女の髪の毛には大象も繋がる
en: a woman's hair can tether even a great elephant

ja: 女は弱しされど母は強し
en: though the woman is weak, the mother is strong

ja: 勝てば官軍、負ければ賊軍
en: win and you are the imperial army; lose and you are rebels

ja: 将を射んと欲すれば先ず馬を射よ
en: to shoot the general, first shoot his horse

ja: 小の虫を殺して大の虫を生かす
en: kill the small bug to save the big bug
small things are big things

ja: 小人閑居して不善をなす
en: the petty man, left idle, does wrong
above the top, there is another top
kindness turns to harm
love lies beyond reason
a god left untouched brings no curse
a sleeping child grows

ja: 寝るほど楽はなかりけり
en: nothing is as easy as sleeping

ja: 心焉に在らざれば視れども見えず
en: if the mind is not there, you look but do not see

ja: 深い川は静かに流れる
en: deep rivers flow quietly
the parents' karma falls on the child

ja: 親はなくても子は育つ
en: children grow up even without parents
gossip lasts only seventy-five days

ja: 人のふり見てわがふり直せ
en: watch how others behave and correct your own ways

ja: 人の蠅を追うより己の蠅を追え
en: chase away your own flies before chasing others'

ja: 人はパンのみにて生くる者に非ず
en: man shall not live by bread alone
a person lives one lifetime; a name lives forever

ja: 人は見かけによらぬもの
en: people are not what they appear
what makes a person is kindness

ja: 人を怨むより身を怨め
en: blame yourself rather than others

ja: 人を見たら泥棒と思え
en: take every stranger for a thief
curse someone and you dig two graves
humans are the lords of all creation
in life, one is moved by another's spirit
human life is a mere fifty years
life's road is hard
people are not made of wood or stone

ja: 水の低きに就くが如し
en: like water flowing to lower ground
where water flows and where people end up cannot be known
water flows downward
